# linux_download (Resource)

Downloads a file from a URL to the host, with `curl` or `wget` run on the host. The file is downloaded again when `url` or `sha256` changes, or when it was modified outside of Terraform. It is replaced atomically, and only once its checksum is verified.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Download a release on the host, checking its digest.
resource "linux_download" "node_exporter" {
  url    = "https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter/releases/download/v1.12.1/node_exporter-1.12.1.linux-amd64.tar.gz"
  sha256 = "b51d8a76aa2a9156a55d501aca6276fae09e262259a5e4e831d2c2222f084e63"
  path   = "/opt/archives/node_exporter-1.12.1.linux-amd64.tar.gz"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Absolute path of the file on the host.
- `url` (String) URL to download, fetched from the host. Any scheme that `curl` (or `wget`) supports, such as `https://` or `file://`. Changing it downloads the file again.

### Optional

- `create_parents` (Boolean) Create missing parent directories. They are not removed with the file. Defaults to `true`.
- `group` (String) Group, as a group name or GID. Defaults to the primary group of the user running the commands.
- `mode` (String) Permissions, in octal. Defaults to `0644`.
- `owner` (String) Owner, as a user name or UID. Defaults to the user running the commands.
- `sha256` (String) Expected SHA-256 digest of the file, hex-encoded. A download with another digest fails and leaves the file as it was. When unset, the digest of the downloaded file. Set it to protect against tampered downloads, and to know the content at plan time.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Path of the file.
